method: Frame 12 (0-based) of the original bundled GIF, decoded and scaled to 960 px wide (Lanczos, aspect kept) with FFmpeg 9.0.2 (ffmpeg -i public/frames/untethered-earth.gif -vf "select=eq(n\,12),scale=960:-2:flags=lanczos" -frames:v 1 frame.png), then encoded with cwebp 1.6.0 (cwebp -q 80 frame.png). No generated imagery.
use: Texture for the Moving Earth sleeve on the 3D record shelf, so the 5.3 MB GIF is fetched only when the record is played. Not sampled for sonification.
credit: NASA / Earth Information Center, as identified by the attributed earth.gov asset mirror. Full production credits and animation date not supplied.
interpretation: A still from the original archived animation; not a live satellite observation or a scientific measurement.
